description: Run whenever a user names a token by ticker or name ("buy BONK"). Tickers aren't unique and copycats reuse them. Never pick a token address from memory. Finds the real token address for a ticker or name, ranks the matches by verification and liquidity, and warns when copycats share the ticker. Inputs: name: The token's ticker, name or address, e.g. "BONK", "Jupiter", "USDC". Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Full field-by-field docs: GET /api/tools/find_token.
name: find_token
